source_note: CrossFit Reverb's official homepage (https://crossfitreverb.net/) links this first-party Astra child stylesheet. The custom accent #BB9064 appears on .preheader, current submenu links, body a, and the even .icon-box in .numbered-box-section. The same stylesheet sets body text to #000000. The separate Astra theme default #0170B9 is excluded.
